The task brief cites Malcheva et al. MNRAS 367, 754 (2006) for Zr I: that paper is on Zr II (opened and checked). The Zr I paper of the same group is Malcheva et al. MNRAS 395, 1523 (2009), used here.

Eustice et al. 2020 state that the linewidth of the 468.9 nm a5F5 - y5G6 cooling line has not been measured; Biémont et al. 1981 give tau(y5G6) = 12.0(5) ns with branching 1.00(1), i.e. Gamma/2pi = 13.3 MHz.

Biémont 1981 Table 1 rows 4805.89 A and 7102.89 A: the wavenumbers and the Kurucz transcription of the same table (gf4000bghl.lab) fix the transitions as a5F4 - y5G4 and a5F3 - z5D2, which is what is entered.
